> extrala wrote:
> Sorry, what's the "experiment" here? The lack of the expansion symbol. I don't get it, sorry.
>
It possibly depends which browser you're looking in. In Chrome, there are two images, shrunk-to-fit alongside each other. In Firefox, one image is full-size, cropped on the right-hand side, and presumably the second image has been pushed out the right-hand side.

So you might want to look at www.veknfrance.com/graphical_design/swallowed1-.jpg vs www.veknfrance.com/graphical_design/swallowed2.jpg where a dual card has been given a background that combines the background of one half of its nature with the other half.
